# Open Data Links

Direct links to APIs and download portals for external data sources used in ForesightAI.

| Data Source | Type | Endpoint / URL | Authentication |
|---|---|---|---|
| NASA EarthData | API | `https://earthdata.nasa.gov/api/v1/` | OAuth2 / API Key |
| OpenStreetMap | Bulk Export | `https://planet.openstreetmap.org/` | None |
| India Data Portal | API | `https://data.gov.in/api/v2/` | API Key Required |
| NOAA GHCN | FTP | `ftp://ftp.ncdc.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/` | None |
| USGS EarthExplorer | Portal | `https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/` | Account Required |
| Kaggle | CSV | `https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/flood-prediction` | Kaggle API Token |
